slides.narration: Chapter 9: The Drishti Bridge. Maya Math counts the examined content. Chakra Math counts the examiner's share. The bridge between them — the Drishti bound — sets the universe's resolution limit.

The Drishti bound D equals phi divided by pi — about 0.515. It means that at each step of the tower, at most 51.5 percent of the content can be resolved. The rest stays hidden — screened away. This single number controls the strength of every force.

Layer after layer, each screening by D, the tower dims its own content. What survives after many layers of screening — the thin sliver still visible — is the particles and forces we observe. Screening is not loss. It is resolution.
